arxiv-2108-04967.title: Gravity Versus Magnetic Fields in Forming Molecular Clouds Journal: ApJ yt ( Turk et al. 2011 ) , Flash ( Fryxell et al. 2000 ) , numpy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 )
arxiv-2108-04967.creator: Juan C. Ibáñez-Mejía, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Ralf S. Klessen
arxiv-2108-04967.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Juan C. Ibáñez-Mejía, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Ralf S. Klessen. Magnetic fields are dynamically important in the diffuse interstellar medium. Understanding how gravitationally bound, star-forming clouds form requires modeling of the fields in a self-consistent, supernova-driven, turbulent, magnetized, stratified disk. We employ the FLASH magnetohydrodynamics code to follow the formation and early evolution of clouds with final masses of 3–8 × 10 3 ​ M ⊙ \times 10^{3}M_{\odot} within such a simulation.

arxiv-2203-03250.title: Cryptographic Security Concerns on Timestamp Sharing via Public Channel in Quantum Key Distribution Systems
arxiv-2203-03250.creator: Melis Pahalı, Utku Tefek, Kadir Durak
arxiv-2203-03250.description: Abstract Quantum key distribution protocols are known to be vulnerable against a side channel attack that exploits the time difference in detector responses used to obtain key bits. The recommended solution against this timing side channel attack is to use a large time bin width instead of high resolution timing information.

arxiv-2206-14116.title: SSL-Lanes: Self-Supervised Learning for Motion Forecasting in Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2206-14116.creator: Prarthana Bhattacharyya Chengjie Huang Krzysztof Czarnecki
arxiv-2206-14116.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning (SSL) is an emerging technique that has been successfully employed to train convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and graph neural networks (GNNs) for more transferable, generalizable, and robust representation learning. However its potential in motion forecasting for autonomous driving has rarely been explored.

arxiv-2302-02082.creator: Sheng Yang, Jesper Sollerman
arxiv-2302-02082.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Sheng Yang, Jesper Sollerman. The progenitors for many types of supernovae (SNe) are still unknown, and an approach to diagnose their physical origins is to investigate the light curve brightness and shape of a large set of SNe. However, it is often difficult to compare and contrast the existing sample studies due to differences in their approaches and assumptions, for example in how to eliminate host galaxy extinction, and this might lead to systematic errors when comparing the results.

arxiv-2302-03610.title: Evaluating a Learned Admission-Prediction Model as a Replacement for Standardized Tests in College Admissions Conference: Proceedings of the Tenth ACM Conference on Learning @ Scale; July 20–22, 2023; Copenhagen, Denmark. Proceedings of the Tenth ACM Conference on Learning @ Scale (L@S ’23), July 20
arxiv-2302-03610.creator: Hansol Lee, René F. Kizilcec, Thorsten Joachims
arxiv-2302-03610.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hansol Lee, René F. Kizilcec, Thorsten Joachims. A growing number of college applications has presented an annual challenge for college admissions in the United States. Admission offices have historically relied on standardized test scores to organize large applicant pools into viable subsets for review. However, this approach may be subject to bias in test scores and selection bias in test-taking with recent trends toward test-optional admission.

arxiv-2309-07723.title: On Salem numbers  which are exceptional units
arxiv-2309-07723.creator: Toufik Zaïmi
arxiv-2309-07723.description: Abstract Abstract. By extending a construction due to Gross and McMullen [6], we show that for any odd integer n and for any even integer d\geq n+3 there are infinitely many Salem numbers \alpha of degree d such that \alpha^{n}-1 is a unit.

arxiv-2401-08642.title: Prediction problem for continuous time stochastic processes with periodically correlated increments observed with noise
arxiv-2401-08642.creator: Maksym Luz, Mikhail Moklyachuk
arxiv-2401-08642.description: Abstract We propose solution of the problem of the mean square optimal estimation of linear functionals which depend on the unobserved values of a continuous time stochastic process with periodically correlated increments based on observations of this process with periodically stationary noise.

arxiv-2402-05219.title: Photochemically-induced acousto-optics in gases
arxiv-2402-05219.creator: P. Michel, L. Lancia, A. Oudin, E. Kur, C. Riconda, K. Ou, V. M. Perez-Ramirez, J. Lee, M. R. Edwards
arxiv-2402-05219.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by P. Michel, L. Lancia, A. Oudin, E. Kur, C. Riconda, K. Ou, V. M. Perez-Ramirez, J. Lee, M. R. Edwards. Acousto-optics consists of launching acoustic waves in a medium (usually a crystal) in order to modulate its refractive index and create a tunable optical grating.

arxiv-2402-19474.title: The All-Seeing Project V2: Towards General Relation Comprehension of the Open World
arxiv-2402-19474.creator: Weiyun Wang, Yiming Ren, Haowen Luo, Tiantong Li, Chenxiang Yan, Zhe Chen, Wenhai Wang, Qingyun Li, Lewei Lu, Xizhou Zhu, Yu Qiao, Jifeng Dai
arxiv-2402-19474.description: Abstract We present the All-Seeing Project V2: a new model and dataset designed for understanding object relations in images. Specifically, we propose the All-Seeing Model V2 (ASMv2) that integrates the formulation of text generation, object localization, and relation comprehension into a relation conversation (ReC) task.

arxiv-2507-03136.title: Holographic Projection and Cyber Attack Surface: A Physical Analogy for Digital Security
arxiv-2507-03136.creator: Ricardo Q. A. Fernandes 1 , Anderson Santos 2,3 , Daniel M. de Carvalho 1 , André Luiz B. Molina 1 1 Secretaria de Segurança da Informação e Cibernética (SSIC/GSI) 2 Instituto Militar de Engenharia (IME) 3 Venturus Centro de Inovação Tecnológica {ricardo.fernandes,daniel.maier,molina}@presidencia.go
arxiv-2507-03136.description: Abstract Abstract This article presents an in-depth exploration of the analogy between the Holographic Principle in theoretical physics and cyber attack surfaces in digital security. Building on concepts such as black hole entropy and AdS/CFT duality, it highlights how complex infrastructures project their vulnerabilities onto their external interfaces.

arxiv-2509-01433.title: Temporal Representation Learning for Ultrasound Analysis using Masked Modeling
arxiv-2509-01433.creator: Yves Stebler, Thomas M. Sutter, Ece Ozkan, Julia E. Vogt
arxiv-2509-01433.description: Abstract Ultrasound (US) imaging is a critical tool in medical diagnostics, offering real-time visualization of physiological processes. One of its major advantages is its ability to capture temporal dynamics, which is essential for assessing motion patterns in applications such as cardiac monitoring, fetal development, and vascular imaging.

arxiv-2512-06946.title: Testing the Significance of the Difference-in-Differences Coefficient via Doubly Randomised Inference
arxiv-2512-06946.creator: Stanisław M. S. Halkiewicz, Andrzej Kałuża
arxiv-2512-06946.description: Abstract This article develops a significance test for the Difference-in-Differences (DiD) estimator based on doubly randomised inference, in which both the treatment and time indicators are permuted to generate an empirical null distribution of the DiD coefficient. Unlike classical t t -tests or single-margin permutation procedures, the proposed method exploits a substantially enlarged randomization space.

arxiv-2601-09791.title: Lessons from the first JUNO results Preprint: IFT-UAM/CSIC-26-3, IPPP/26/03, YITP-SB-2026-02
arxiv-2601-09791.creator: Ivan Esteban, M. C. Gonzalez-Garcia, Michele Maltoni, Ivan Martinez-Soler, João Paulo Pinheiro, Thomas Schwetz
arxiv-2601-09791.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Ivan Esteban, M. C. Gonzalez-Garcia, Michele Maltoni, Ivan Martinez-Soler, João Paulo Pinheiro, Thomas Schwetz. First results from the JUNO reactor neutrino experiment already determine with world-leading precision the small neutrino squared-mass splitting Δ ​ m 21 2 \Delta m^{2}_{21} and the mixing angle θ 12 \theta_{12} . In this article we perform an exploratory study beyond these, taking advantage of the first JUNO data release to discuss its sensitivity to the large squared-mass splitting, Δ ​ m 3 ​ ℓ 2 \Delta m^{2}_{3\ell} .

arxiv-2601-19219.title: Site preference of chalcogen atoms in 1T ′ M ​ X 2 ​ ( 1 − x ) ​ Y 2 ​ x MX_{2(1-x)}Y_{2x} ( M = M= Mo and W; X , Y = X,Y= S, Se, and Te)
arxiv-2601-19219.creator: Shota Ono, Ryotaro Ohse
arxiv-2601-19219.description: Abstract The insulator-metal transition, accompanying the structural phase transition from 2H to 1T ′ structure, has been reported in two-dimensional W-S-Te and W-Se-Te systems. It is also reported that Te atoms tend to occupy a specific site of the 1T ′ structure.

arxiv-2602-07633.title: Flow-Based Conformal Predictive Distributions
arxiv-2602-07633.creator: Trevor A. Harris
arxiv-2602-07633.description: Abstract Conformal prediction provides a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification via prediction sets with exact finite-sample coverage. In low dimensions these sets are easy to interpret, but in high-dimensional or structured output spaces they are difficult to represent and use, which can limit their ability to integrate with downstream tasks such as sampling and probabilistic forecasting.

pmc-10542376.title: PET-measured human dopamine synthesis capacity and receptor availability predict trading rewards and time-costs during foraging
pmc-10542376.creator: Angela M Ianni, Daniel P Eisenberg, Erie D Boorman, Sara M Constantino, Catherine E Hegarty, Michael D Gregory, Joseph C Masdeu, Philip D Kohn, Timothy E Behrens, Karen F Berman
pmc-10542376.description: Foraging behavior requires weighing costs of time to decide when to leave one reward patch to search for another. Computational and animal studies suggest that striatal dopamine is key to this process; however, the specific role of dopamine in foraging behavior in humans is not well characterized.

pmc-10557190.title: Social connectedness and suicidal ideation: the roles of perceived burdensomeness and thwarted belongingness in the distress to suicidal ideation pathway
pmc-10557190.creator: Peter Richard Gill, Michael Arena, Christopher Rainbow, Warwick Hosking, Kim M Shearson, Gavin Ivey, Jenny Sharples
pmc-10557190.description: BackgroundSuicide is a serious public health issue. Distress has been identified as a common risk factor, with research also suggesting that a lack of social connectedness is involved.MethodsThis quantitative, cross-sectional study investigated the role of perceived burdensomeness and thwarted belongingness in the psychological distress/suicidal ideation pathway in a community sample of 480 Australian adults.

pmc-10599343.title: Management of Myopic Maculopathy: A Review
pmc-10599343.creator: William J. Anderson, Levent Akduman
pmc-10599343.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Myopia, including pathologic myopia, has seen a significant increase in prevalence in recent years. It is a significant cause of irreversible vision loss worldwide and prediction models demonstrate the substantial future impact on the population. With increased awareness and research, it is possible to prevent blindness on a large scale in the younger, productive age group affected by myopic maculopathy (MM). The vision-threatening manifestations of pathologic myopia include myopic choroidal neovascularization, macular atrophy, maculoschisis, macular hole, and retinal detachment.

pmc-11359829.title: Deep Learning-Based Transmitter Localization in Sparse Wireless Sensor Networks
pmc-11359829.creator: Runjie Liu, Qionggui Zhang, Yuankang Zhang, Rui Zhang, Tao Meng, Zhiyuan Luo, Khuong An Nguyen
pmc-11359829.description: In the field of wireless communication, transmitter localization technology is crucial for achieving accurate source tracking. However, the extant methodologies for localization face numerous challenges in wireless sensor networks (WSNs), particularly due to the constraints posed by the sparse distribution of sensors across large areas. We present DSLoc, a deep learning-based approach for transmitter localization in sparse WSNs.

pmc-11456803.title: Testicular large B‐cell lymphoma is genetically similar to PCNSL and distinct from nodal DLBCL
pmc-11456803.creator: Alfredo Rivas‐Delgado, Cristina López, Guillem Clot, Ferran Nadeu, Marta Grau, Gerard Frigola, Jan Bosch‐Schips, Josefine Radke, Naveed Ishaque, Miguel Alcoceba, Gustavo Tapia, Luis Luizaga, Carmen Barcena, Nicholas Kelleher, Neus Villamor, Tycho Baumann, Ana Muntañola, Juan M Sancho‐Cia, Alejandro
pmc-11456803.description: Testicular large B‐cell lymphoma (TLBCL) is an infrequent and aggressive lymphoma arising in an immune‐privileged site and has recently been recognized as a distinct entity from diffuse large B‐cell lymphoma (DLBCL). We describe the genetic features of TLBCL and compare them with published series of nodal DLBCL and primary large B‐cell lymphomas of the CNS (PCNSL).

pmc-11474577.title: Editorial to “Acute occlusion of the left main coronary artery following impedance rise after high‐frequency catheter ablation”: Prepare for a disastrous matter in the EP laboratory
pmc-11474577.creator: Satoshi Higa
pmc-11474577.description: and implanted a drug‐eluting stent, coronary angiography showed a 99% in‐stent acute stenosis requiring repeat balloon dilatations. Intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) revealed intimal thickening and tissue protrusion within the stent. Finally, the in‐stent restenosis completely resolved after additional balloon dilatations. The patient was successfully weaned from assisted circulation and was discharged on postoperative Day 7.

pmc-11615981.title: The association between osteoprotegerin and arterial stiffness in a 10-year longitudinal study of patients with type 2 diabetes
pmc-11615981.creator: Serena Low, Sharon Pek, Angela Moh, Jian-Jun Liu, Bhuvaneswari Pandian, Keven Ang, Wern Ee Tang, Ziliang Lim, Tavintharan Subramaniam, Chee Fang Sum, Su Chi Lim
pmc-11615981.description: Introduction: Osteoprotegerin (OPG) inhibits vascular calcification which is central to pathogenesis of arterial stiffness. However, it promotes inflammation by upregulating expression of vascular cell adhesion molecule-1(VCAM-1), thereby contributing to arterial stiffness. We investigated longitudinal association between OPG and arterial stiffness in type 2 diabetes (T2D), causality of the association and mediation by VCAM-1.

pmc-12666441.title: A rare case of Streptococcus pyogenes vertebral osteomyelitis in a young, immunocompetent male
pmc-12666441.creator: Saran Lal Ajai Mokan Dasan, Balakrishnan Arivalagan, Pranav Singla, Yusra Shah, Raydi Mejia Landron, Angel Barrera Ventura
pmc-12666441.description: Streptococcus pyogenes (Group A Streptococcus, GAS) is a well-recognized cause of invasive infections. However, it’s an uncommon etiologic microorganism in adult vertebral osteomyelitis. We report a rare case of vertebral osteomyelitis, discitis, epidural abscess, and bilateral psoas abscesses caused by GAS in an otherwise healthy male.

pmc-13132963.title: MyomiR Networks in Spinal Muscular Atrophy: Associations With Clinical Severity and Treatment Response
pmc-13132963.creator: Maruša Barbo, Blaž Koritnik, Lea Leonardis, Vita Dolžan, Metka Ravnik-Glavač
pmc-13132963.description: Disease-modifying therapies have significantly influenced the clinical course of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA), yet objective biomarkers for monitoring disease progression and treatment remain limited. We profiled four muscle-specific miRNAs (myomiRs), ten bioinformatically predicted mRNA targets, two functionally associated lncRNAs, and SMN transcripts in whole blood from 50 adults with SMA types II–IV.

pmc-13161523.title: Efficacy and Safety of Oral Icotrokinra in Moderate‐to‐Severe Plaque Psoriasis: A Systematic Review, Meta‐Analysis, and Trial Sequential Analysis
pmc-13161523.creator: Alhasan Altayf, Munder Lateiresh, Lutfiyah Marwan, Mohamed Yaseen Alfeetouri, Yassine Zouaoui, Muhammed Elhadi
pmc-13161523.description: Oral therapies for moderate‐to‐severe plaque psoriasis are limited by modest efficacy or safety concerns. Icotrokinra is a novel oral interleukin‐23 receptor antagonist peptide that has shown promising efficacy in randomized trials. This study aimed to systematically evaluate the efficacy and safety of icotrokinra in patients with moderate‐to‐severe plaque psoriasis.

pmc-13239088.title: Primary Extramedullary Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia Presenting as Cauda Equina Syndrome: A Rare Case Report and Diagnostic Challenge
pmc-13239088.creator: Amir Ali, Marc Ringor, Arbab Khalid, Diana Garcia, Ravishankar Konchada, Ramalingam Ratnasabapathy, Yuna Chae, Arman Melikyan, George Yaghmour
pmc-13239088.description: APL presenting as an extramedullary mass is exceedingly rare. Here, we describe extramedullary APL causing cauda equina syndrome, underscoring the diagnostic challenges associated with an atypical presentation, highlighting the complexity of distinguishing extramedullary APL from other conditions, and discussing the stepwise approach to diagnosis.

pmc-13261540.title: Biovigilance in Faecal Microbiota Transplantation: 7‐Year Cohort Study and Framework for Microbiological Assessments of Infectious Adverse Events
pmc-13261540.creator: V O Chernova, J van Prehn, B Groenewegen, E van Lingen, E J Kuijper, M M C Lambregts, E van Nood, G Choi, M D Hazenberg, J J Keller, E M Terveer
pmc-13261540.description: Background and AimsFaecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) is increasingly used. However, no systematic approach exists to assess infectious risks after FMT, leading to underreporting. We evaluated infectious complications at the Netherlands Donor Feces Bank (NDFB) and proposed a structured biovigilance approach aligned with the EU Regulation on Substances of Human Origin (SoHO).
